data.name: Jarvis
data.gender_notes: Jarvis is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English ‘geard’ meaning ‘spear’ and ‘weorð’ meaning ‘man’ or ‘warrior’. Jarvis can be translated as ‘warrior friend’ or ‘spearman’. In Christian context, Jarvis can symbolize a strong, loyal, and devoted companion, reminding us of the faithful companionship of God. The name Jarvis carries the meaning “Friend, companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jarvis usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who is wise and nurturing, like a mother or teacher.
data.etymology: Jarvis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jarvis total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: גארביס
in_hebrew.meaning: גארביס נגזר מהשם העברי גארב ומשמעותו לוחם אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גארביס מקורו בשם העברי גארב, שפירושו לוחם אלוהים או שומר האל. השם קשור לשורש העברי ג־ר־ב, שפירושו להלחם או להיות קשוח. היסטורית, השם גארב מופיע בתנ"ך כדמות ששמרה על עם ישראל מפני אויביהם. בהקשר הרוחני, השם גארביס מייצג הגנה אלוהית וחוזק רוחני.

in_greek.name: Γιάρβις
in_greek.meaning: Γιάρβις σημαίνει Θεοσ προστακτής ή Ιππότης του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιάρβις προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή ρίζα ג־ר־ב, που σημαίνει 'να αγωνίζεται' ή 'να είναι σκληρός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, η έννοια του ονόματος συνδέεται με την προστασία και τη δύναμη που προέρχεται από τον Θεό. Ιστορικά, το όνομα Γιάρβις έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία ως σύμβολο της πνευματικής δύναμης και της προστασίας του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Jarvis
in_latin.meaning: Jarvis significat Dei defensor seu Miles Dei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jarvis derivatur ex hebraeo גארב, quod significat 'pugnare' vel 'esse durus'. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Jarvis non invenitur directe, sed sensus eius cum protectione et fortitudine divina coniungitur. Historice, Jarvis ut nomen Christianum significat devotionem et protectionem divinam.

in_english.name: Jarvis
in_english.meaning: Jarvis means 'God's servant' or 'one who serves God'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jarvis originates from the Hebrew root ג־ר־ב (Garb), meaning 'to fight' or 'to be stern'. It is interpreted as 'God's servant' or 'one who serves God', symbolizing spiritual strength and divine protection. Historically, Jarvis has been used in Christian tradition to denote someone who is devoted to serving God. The name carries connotations of courage, loyalty, and spiritual vigilance.
